frontline.description: Triggers when creature is placed in frontline position at battle start

backline.description: Triggers when creature is placed in backline position at battle start

on_placement.description: Triggers when creature is placed on the field
on_placement.timing: During prep phase or mid-battle swap

on_buff.description: Triggers when creature gains a buff effect
on_buff.timing: Whenever any buff is applied to this creature

on_debuff.description: Triggers when creature gains a debuff effect
on_debuff.timing: Whenever any debuff is applied to this creature

on_kill.description: Triggers when creature kills an enemy

ally_dies.description: Triggers when any allied creature dies

passive.description: Always active, triggers every turn or per attack

low_health.description: Triggers when creature's health drops below threshold

dot.scaling: Damage per second or per round

taunt.description: Force enemies to attack this unit

increase_health.description: Restore health or grant temporary health
increase_health.scaling: Flat amount or percent of max HP

creatingNewCreature: 1. Copy the creature template structure (id, name, type, role, shopTier, description, typePassive, tiers)
3. Fill baseStats (health, attack, speed) - tier 2 should be ~1.5x, tier 3 should be ~2.25x
5. Each ability has: name, id, trigger, description, effects array
6. Effects array can have 1-3 effects, but should all serve the same core ability fantasy
7. Keep abilities aligned with the trigger x effect matrix

scalingGuideline.speed: Usually constant (1-3 range), or +1 at star 3
scalingGuideline.shopTierMultiplier: T1=1.0x, T2=1.15x, T3=1.3x, T4=1.5x on base stats

abilityScopingRules: Keep the core fantasy consistent across all 3 tiers
Tier 1 = baseline effect with basic numbers
Tier 2 = same effect, stronger numbers (usually 2x scaling)
Tier 3 = same effect, strongest numbers (usually 3x tier 1)
Do NOT change the trigger between tiers - same trigger across all 3

tribePassives.Spirit: Bone Summoner - Summons Bones on faint (10/5/1 -> 15/8/1 -> 20/10/1)
tribePassives.Flora: Nature's Vigor - HP bonus (+2 -> +4 -> +4 HP + 2 dmg reduction)
tribePassives.Kami: Spirit Economy - Gold bonus (1 -> 2 -> 3 extra gold)
tribePassives.Dessert: Sweet Revenge - Damage on faint (1 random -> 2 random -> 3 all)
